verdict.rationale: Riveter's docs mention it 'reads PDFs and images' as part of a workflow and combines results with web data (riveter-docs-18), implying some visual-content interpretation, but there is no explicit description of generating textual captions for images embedded in a scraped page specifically to feed a text-only model. missing for 10: explicit caption-generation feature, example output showing image-to-text captions, confirmation that scraped pages' embedded images are captioned automatically.
